name: Scroll Stack
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; sticky-positioned cards pile up natively as the page scrolls, and a small IO-gated scroll listener adds a scale-and-dim depth cue without the upstream smooth-scroll dependency.

top.description: Distance from the top of the scroll container where the first card pins, in px.

offset.description: Extra pin offset per card, in px, so a ledge of each earlier card stays visible.

gap.description: Scroll distance between cards before they stack, in px.

scaleStep.description: Scale lost per card stacked on top.

dim.description: Brightness lost per card stacked on top.

maxDepth.description: Maximum number of stacked cards that keep adding depth.

a11y: Cards stay in DOM order and nothing is cloned or aria-hidden, so screen readers read every card once, in sequence.
Scrolling is never hijacked or smoothed: wheel, touch, keyboard and scrollbar scrolling behave natively.
A card that holds keyboard focus (:focus-within) rises above the pile at full size and brightness, so a focused link or button is never covered.
Reduced motion keeps the plain sticky stacking but drops the scale and dim depth cue and attaches no scroll listener.
